subject: Seven Acres Cemetery Expansion
overview: The board discussed public outreach and timeline plans for the proposed Seven Acres cemetery expansion to address impending grave shortages. Trustees also received updates on staffing, veteran plot capacity, and restoration work at Cross Street Cemetery.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board unanimously approved the previous meeting's minutes as written.

items.title: Seven Acres Cemetery Expansion
items.summary: Clayton reported on discussions with the mayor regarding the Seven Acres expansion to address burial capacity projected to run out in approximately three years, outlining plans for historical education, a press release, community polling, and a subsequent public hearing.

items.title: Cemetery Maintenance and Cross Street Restoration Updates
items.summary: Updates were shared on fountain winterization, gravel removal, and the Cross Street Cemetery project, where monument restoration and ground-penetrating radar surveys are nearly complete pending gate repairs.

items.title: Grave Capacity, Mausoleum Proposal, and Staffing
items.summary: Steve reported that developed Vietnam veteran plots are at capacity, discussions are underway with engineering to design a multi-conflict veterans section, burial rights were acquired for an adjacent private mausoleum, and newly hired grounds staff will bring maintenance up to full staffing.
